title: Michael Don't Leave Me Here
blurb: Beneath the jump scares, Five Nights at Freddy's is a story about a family, and this is one of the lines where the mask slips. It is screamed rather than spoken, and the desperation in it is real, the kind the series usually keeps hidden behind animatronics and static. Fans who have followed the lore know exactly what it costs. Everyone else just hears somebody being abandoned. Play it theatrically when a friend drops out of a Discord call without warning, or play it sincerely if you happen to understand the timeline.
origin: A line from Five Nights at Freddy's lore, adopted by the fandom.
